text: I never beg for sky so high or houses falling from the sky. One minute I was chasing cats. Next thing I know, crash Darthy's flat. A cloud of dust, a witch's scream. But Dorothy stayed strong in the dream. She held me close, heart full of shock while I just scanned the yellow rock. The air was sweet but strange and wrong with singing trees and rainbow song. The lion growled. I didn't move. He shook like leaves with something to prove. The straw man smiled with stitched upright but lost his stuff in every stride. And tin man stiff with hollow tone would freeze up solid if left alone.

Oh, total love. You're brave. You true. You walk through fire and follow through. When skies turn and witches flew, you stayed by me. You always do. >> Through poppy fields so deep, so wide. Where dreams did pull and truth did hide. I barked and bit. I kicked and fought to keep her safe. That's all I thought. The wizard roared, the fire rose high, but I could see it was a lie. So if you think I'm just a pet, you haven't heard my journey yet. Through I ran on four small feet with rhythm strong and reggae beat  your heart and flame. Through every storm you knew my name. If ours was wild and full of fright. You were my root. You were my life.
